scientific_integrity: A fully reproducible exhaustive finite-order computation and an exact thirteen-vertex witness, with an independently established conditional-independence reduction. General tripod factorization and independence-polynomial identities are background rather than original contributions. Historical priority is provisional, and there has been no independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Minimality proved for finite simple trees with at most twelve vertices and uniform positive fugacity only.
No classification or uniqueness claim for thirteen-vertex examples or higher-order trees.
The proof of the sharp finite cutoff uses an exact exhaustive enumeration with verifiable standard-library code.
title: Thirteen sites are necessary for reentrant three-point hard-core correlations on trees
